snippet.title: Velocity Redux: Acceledrome Online Battle! (Hot Wheels Fangame)
snippet.description:
Download 0.4.0 on itch.io: https://alaxend0l.itch.io/velocity-redux
Hang out with the community on our Discord server! https://discord.gg/vDZ737XmKF
Momentum by AcceleReece: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RiXsWuSa30w

Hey y'all! This is something we've wanted to do for a long time. Thanks to General Kenobi, we were able to create brawls in the Acceledrome! Subscribe if you want to keep up to date with the project!

#velocity #x #acceleracers  #hotwheels #velocityx #velocityredux #fangame
